construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored for this isolated build

shared_schema.input: document string; schema.fields list of {name,label,type,required}; schema.question_field references a text field; knowledge_base list of {id,question,answer,required_fields}; optional positive integer min_overlap
shared_schema.field_output: value, source {start,end,text} or null, state present/missing/invalid
shared_schema.validation: Shared field declarations enforce schema, extracted types, source span consistency, completeness and FAQ template grounding. Unknown keys, duplicate field/knowledge identifiers, duplicate JSON keys and unsafe placeholders are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated extraction is the only source of FAQ question and template values. FAQ validates the extraction again before retrieval.
Missing or invalid required extraction values cause abstention; optional values only block answers that depend on them.
Answers are rendered verbatim from one cited knowledge entry with validated extracted substitutions.

behavior.synthetic_data: All example customer, order and shop policy data are explicitly synthetic.
behavior.extraction: Literal case-sensitive labels anchored to lines; trimmed values; Python Unicode character offsets, start inclusive/end exclusive. Repeated labels are invalid, blanks are missing, signed decimal integers are supported.
behavior.retrieval: Casefolded unique Unicode alphanumeric token overlap between extracted question and KB questions, minus fixed English stopwords; descending score and id ordering; default minimum overlap 2; top-score ties abstain.
behavior.cli: Exactly one JSON object on stdout; successful processing including abstention exits 0; input validation, decoding and file errors return status error and exit 2.

included: Integrated deterministic extraction and FAQ pipeline
Grounded templated answers and explicit abstention

coverage: Corrupted handoff and invented answer rejection
CLI success, usage, invalid JSON, schema and file failures
